1. **.js shims are load-bearing, not build artifacts.** Every non-test .ts in packages/scheduler/src has a tracked sibling `<name>.js` containing `export * from "./<name>.ts";`. Node resolves the `.js` specifiers used in imports under `--experimental-strip-types` (scheduler-runtime-entrypoint.test.ts spawns a real Worker with that flag). I added validate-graph-input.js and validate-graph-structure.js for that reason — without them the smoke test fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Only test-fixtures.ts lacks a shim, because nothing imports it at runtime.

Verified equivalent across all three cases and now locked by a new test: a malformed node record must suppress BOTH the unknown-endpoint and the absent-completion finding, leaving exactly one GRAPH_MALFORMED_NODE issue. Every other moved block diffs byte-identical against HEAD modulo variable renames.
